title: Canonical restricted open cohomology cocones in arbitrary degree
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ a cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$, with inverse-image transitions $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical identity and composition equations. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(c.pt_{\acute et})$ have isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ and arrows conjugate to the inverse-image composition comparison followed by $c_j^*\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a cocone on $G$. Fix a scheme $X$, $i_0\in I$, $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$ and $W\subseteq X$ open. Put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$, $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$ and $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. The restricted transition $W_k\to W_j$ and projection $W_L\to W_j$ are the restrictions of the original maps. Their coefficient maps are the inverse-image composition comparisons followed by the restrictions of $\varphi_f$ or $(eG_j)^{-1};L_j$, respectively. Write $T_W^n(f)$ and $\lambda_W^n(j)$ for the resulting maps on cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], namely pullback followed by the cohomology map of that coefficient map. For every $n\ge0$ there are a functor $K:J\to\operatorname{Ab}$, isomorphisms $e_j:K_j\cong H^n(W_j,F_j|_{W_j})$, and a natural transformation $\iota:K\to\mathrm{const}(H^n(W_L,L.pt|_{W_L}))$ such that $K(f)=e_j;T_W^n(f);e_k^{-1}$ and $\iota_j=e_j;\lambda_W^n(j)$. No scheme limit, compactness, affine transition, or sheaf colimit is assumed.

proof.text: Use the actual stage cohomology groups as objects and the canonical arrows as maps. Their identity and composition laws make a functor. Take identity object identifications.

Use the actual limit-open cohomology as constant point and the canonical legs as components. Their naturality makes a natural transformation. Simplify identity compositions and unfold the canonical formula aliases by reflexivity to obtain the required equations.

theorem etale_limit_open_cohomology_cocone_degree
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) :
    let BW := AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj L.pt) n)
    ∃ (K : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (eK : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, K.obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ W j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n)),
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k), K.map f =
        (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ W F φ n f ≫ (eK k).inv) ∧
      ∃ (ι : K ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj BW),
        ∀ j, ι.app j = (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ W F G eG L n j
